content: To navigate these complex processes, industry stakeholders frequently participate in specialized conferences, such as those hosted by the World Academy of Science, Engineering and Technology, which facilitate in-depth discussions on supply chain optimization, strategic sourcing, and advanced risk management [35] . Despite the existence of clear guidelines, the industry faces challenges regarding the uniform application of these standards. A recent communication from the SAISC in May 2026 highlighted discrepancies in professional practices within the steel industry, asserting that not all stakeholders adhere to uniform standards [45] . This indicates that the SAISC continues to advocate for strict adherence to established grading and structural guidelines across the sector, reinforcing its crucial role in standardization, even if it stops short of detailing specific grading criteria in broad public communications [45] .
